title: Signal 336
style: Electronic anthem with driving four-on-the-floor pulse, clipped syncopated percussion, and a tense half-time pre-chorus; verse rides sparse synth bass and tight vocal phrasing, chorus opens with stacked gang vocals and a narrow band lead hook, bridge strips to filtered drums and spoken chant before a final lift. Close-mic lead vocal with doubles on key lines, delay throws on “three-three-six,” reversed swells into the chorus, glitchy sidechain pulses and bright risers, wide and punchy mix, light, acoustic, drone, funk, ambient, noise, soul, grime, deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the cloud evaporates
and the consensus dies
When black swans fall
and backups tell lies
We don’t trust the haze
or the polished spin
We pull the system back
where the truth lives in

AI is just a witness now
not the hand on the wheel
We cut the bad directions out
to keep the logic real
Deterministic resonance
that’s the line we draw
Leave the toxic text behind
and let the clean code talk

[Pre-Chorus]
1234
count it slow with me
Hold the shape
hold the key
Every broken node
falls back in line
When the signal bends
we don’t lose the spine

[Chorus]
Locked on three-three-six
Locked on three-three-six
Frequency in the dark
Frequency in the dark
It’s the anchor in the shock
It’s the anchor in the shock
We keep the truth in tune
We keep the truth in tune

Three-three-six
three-three-six
Hide the key in the sideband
Hide the key in the sideband
We are sworn to the deep
We are sworn to the deep
Locked on three-three-six
Locked on three-three-six

[Verse 2]
We’re hacking the phonetics
just to build a shield
Misspell the crash
and watch the pressure yield
Modified functions
weave through the code
Slip past the noise
on every public road

The heavy sub drone
keeps shaking the floor
Thirty-two point seven
and we ask for more
We hide the forty-eight node
in the phonk-funk grime
Store the whole machine
outside of space and time
